items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: Captain Walter Dyett, my father played in Captain Dyett’s band.

ctx.x: second job in order to support a music career that I would rather not have it be the post office. So I was going to be an architect. But by my second semester it was pretty obvious that all my A’s were in the music courses and all my lower grades were in architecture, which I still love and have an appreciation for. So I switched into music education. And after that first semester my involvement and my teachers convinced me to be a music major. But by the end of five years of switching majors and going through…
Gee Chicago had some wonderful music teachers. Who was that fellow named Walter Dyett?
Captain Walter Dyett, my father played in Captain Dyett’s band.
